about: fences() as the legacy discovery found them at 456df2a, before the construct set was generalised. The default mode of tools/daml_mutate.py must keep returning exactly this.

step-1-mandate: assertMsg "no approved address for that asset on that network" (matches /= [])
assertMsg "this network requires a memo or tag and none was given" (not needsMemo || not (isNone memo))
assertMsg "asset, network and address are all required" (asset /= "" && network /= "" && address /= "")
assertMsg "no deposit feed is configured for this desk" (depositFeed /= None)
assertMsg "a transaction reference is required; a screenshot is not a confirmation" (txRef /= "")
assertMsg "off-taker wallet is not approved for that asset and network" ((offTaker, asset, network, toAddress) `elem` wallets)
assertMsg "naira received is short of the amount agreed" (received >= expectedNaira)
assertMsg "rate is outside the band the principal set" (rate >= rateFloor && rate <= rateCeiling)
assertMsg "naira does not equal the crypto amount times the rate" (optional False (\c -> c > 0.0 && abs (c * rate - nairaAmount) < 0.01) cryptoAmount)
assertMsg "that is not one of the desk's approved naira accounts" (payIntoAccount `elem` accounts)
assertMsg "the desk cannot send that asset on that network" ((asset, network) `elem` canSend)
assertMsg "a receiving wallet must be given when the rate is agreed" (customerWallet /= "")
assertMsg "a rate band must be positive and the right way round" (floor > 0.0 && ceiling >= floor)
assertMsg "a bank reference is required; a screenshot is not a confirmation" (bankRef /= "")
assertMsg "naira credited is short of the amount quoted" (credited >= nairaAmount)
assertMsg "no bank feed is configured for this desk" (bankFeed /= None)
assertMsg "a bank reference is required (bank feed); a screenshot is not a confirmation" (bankRef /= "")
assertMsg "naira credited is short of the amount quoted (bank feed)" (credited >= nairaAmount)
assertMsg "naira has not been confirmed credited by the principal" nairaConfirmed
assertMsg "receiving wallet does not match the one fixed when the rate was agreed" (toWallet == customerWallet)
assertMsg "sending on a different network from the one quoted" (onNetwork == network)
assertMsg "released amount does not match the crypto amount quoted" (amount == optional (nairaAmount / rate) identity cryptoAmount)
assertMsg "charge would exceed the cap" (spent + amount <= cap)
assertMsg "payee is not on the allow-list" (payee `elem` allowed)
assertMsg "charge would exceed the period limit" withinPeriod
assertMsg "new cap below what is already spent" (newCap >= spent)
assertMsg "payout account has not been approved by the principal" (payoutAccount `elem` approved)
assertMsg "rate is outside the band the principal set" (rate >= rateFloor && rate <= rateCeiling)
assertMsg "an account must have a name" (account /= "")
assertMsg "a rate band must be positive and the right way round" (floor > 0.0 && ceiling >= floor)
assertMsg "deposit does not carry this quote's reference" (depositRef == reference)
assertMsg "amount does not match the quote" (amount == expectedAmount)
assertMsg "payout account does not match the account named in the quote" (claimedAccount == payoutAccount)
step-0-refusal: assertMsg "an attempt needs a salt, or the commitment does not hide"
assertMsg "a commitment is a 64 character sha256 digest"
assertMsg "ending a schedule needs a reason" (reason /= "")
ensure shard >= 0 && attempts >= 0 && length refusals <= attempts
assertMsg "a commitment is a 64 character sha256 digest"
